gitCommit.subject: feat(collections): delete a collection from Settings (owner-only) (#228)
gitCommit.body:
feat(collections): delete a collection from Settings (owner-only) (#228)

* feat(collections): owner can delete a collection from Settings (purses-* delete-collection)

No UI existed to delete a collection (the purge backend did: owner-only
POST /api/collections/[id]/purge with a type-the-name confirm). Add a DeleteCollectionSection
to the edit/Settings page, rendered ONLY for the owner: a danger zone -> reveal a
type-the-exact-name confirm (matches the route's confirm contract) -> POST purge ->
redirect to /collections. Honest about permanence ('removes the collection and
everything in it … can't be undone'); idempotency guard; gentle error.

- Unit (6): reveal-only, Delete disabled until exact name typed, purge POSTs {confirm:name}
  + redirects, double-submit = one call, Cancel backs out, failed purge keeps you put.
- E2E (real seam): owner types the name -> real cascade purge -> lands on /collections.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01NpkGzYgcy23jUToNwgjSw9

* test(collections): edit page shows delete-collection only to the owner (gate)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01NpkGzYgcy23jUToNwgjSw9

* fix(collections): fold #228 review — shared Input (44px), focus mgmt, honest confirm

- Use the shared Input primitive for the confirm field (48px tap target + canonical
  focus ring; was a hand-rolled <40px input) [UX major, DESIGN.md/PRODUCT.md].
- Move focus into the field on reveal + role=group label — no keyboard dead-end on
  the app's most destructive action [UX/Craftsman major]. (+focus test)
- Send the user's TYPED value as confirm (not the server-echoed name) so the wire
  carries real intent [Security nit/Craftsman minor].
